rationale: All 8 starts are feasible with wide margins (0 DRC, hold slack >= +0.08 ns, <=101 slew/cap pins vs bar 953), so only setup matters. The tightest targets (frac 0.48-0.50) gave the best T_eff and still had +0.22 to +0.56 ns slack, so the design is not yet at its limit: push the target to the 0.45 floor (8.49 ns). Setting 1 is the best run (des: DELAY 4, cap213, post-GRT timing repair) with only the target tightened, a clean exploit. Setting 2 grafts the second-best run's (md5) timing-driven placement, ABC sizing/buffering and post-GRT design repair onto DELAY 4 + cap213 at similar density, to test whether they stack.
